DellLogEntry.description: This is the schema definition for the additional OEM properties to complement DMTF LogEntry Schema.
DellLogEntry.longDescription: This resource shall be used to represent an OEM LogEntry for a Redfish implementation.

^([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)?@(odata|Redfis.description: This property shall specify a valid odata or Redfish property.

AgentID.description: Property to represent agentID of event that has occurred.
AgentID.longDescription: The value of the property specifies the agentID of event.

BitMask.description: Property to represent action filter bit mask of event that has occurred.
BitMask.longDescription: The value of the property specifies the action filter bit mask of event.

Category.description: Property to represent category of Event that has occurred.
Category.longDescription: The value of the property specifies the category of Event.

Comment.description: Property to display any comment that might have been added to the log entry.
Comment.longDescription: Property to display any comment that might have been added to the log entry.

FQDD.description: Property to represent Fully Qualified Device Descriptor of an instance.
FQDD.longDescription: The value of the property represents Fully Qualified Device Descriptor of an instance.

Id.description: Property represents the Id of an instance.

LastUpdatedByUser.description: Property to display UserName of the user that last commented on the log entry.
LastUpdatedByUser.longDescription: Property to display UserName of the user that last commented on the log entry.

Name.description: Property represents the Name of an instance.

SubSystem.description: Property to represent SubSystem of the FQDD.
SubSystem.longDescription: The value of the property specifies the SubSystem of FQDD.
